note: 2.60.1 (B-29): board and record files a commit on the studio's branch may change while a merge train is verified without the train verifying again (harness/train.mjs boardOnlyMove). The train's copy never tests studio/ from its tree (studio/ is sparse-excluded there and linked to the main checkout's), so these paths can't change what its verify saw. Only these: anything else (studio/protected.json, studio/game.json, studio/gates.json, keys, any code, any golden) still means a new verify; 2.77.0: an added approval (addOnlyPaths) doesn't, and a file only some checks read (recheckPaths) re-runs just those checks. A deleted or renamed path never counts here; 2.78.2 (g): when this rule refuses, a move whose commits touch only board files no check reads (train.mjs nonCodeReaders: not a record, approval or recheckPaths file, not read by docs, session or reviewer, nor by a game check's paths) lands the verified tree with them merged on top (STUDIO_TRAIN_LAND_OVER_NONCODE). Repo-relative globs (** any depth, * one segment).
taskRecordsNote: 2.67.0 (B-29): task records a board move may also change, as path -> the key that holds the entries (a map by task id, or a list of entries with a "task" field), only when every entry it changes is for a task that is not a lane of the running train (a `task yes` or a hold for another task). A change to an entry of a lane in the train, to another key, or to an entry without a task still means a new verify.
addOnlyNote: 2.76.0+ (2.77.0, P9.1): files a board move may ADD (never change or delete) without a new verify: a new approval only lets more changes pass the protected check, never fewer, and no check reads it otherwise.
recheckNote: 2.77.0 (P9.1): files a required check reads, path glob -> the check ids that read them. When main moves by these (and board files) only while a train is verified, the train re-runs just those checks on the new tree (run-gates --only) instead of the whole verify; green lands, red verifies again in full. A check id the studio doesn't have is skipped (nothing reads the file).
